columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Import Batch Id, every batch  of data being imported should be assigned a batch id.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a record within a batch, source system should populate this.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of row in the interface table, source system should leave this as null.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: Used by import utility to relate the record in interface table to the file row.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: ACTION_CODE

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Used internally by the bulk import ODI program.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: FUSION_PRICING_TERM_ID
columns.description: PRICING_TERM_ID of this record in FUSION.

columns.name: MAJOR_VERSION
columns.description: Identifies the contract major version.

columns.name: EXT_SOURCE
columns.description: User or External key, to enable  updates or deletes via bulk import or web services, if fusion primary key is not known.

columns.name: EXT_KEY
columns.description: See ext_source

columns.name: DNZ_CHR_ID
columns.description: Contract ID.  Denormalized for performance.

columns.name: CLE_ID
columns.description: Parent Line ID of this record

columns.name: LINE_EXT_SOURCE
columns.description: Parent line external source

columns.name: LINE_EXT_KEY
columns.description: Parent line external key

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE
columns.description: e.g. %Discount, %Markup, etc. Based on a lookup type OKC_SAGR_ADJ_TYPES

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup type OKC_SAGR_ADJ_TYPES

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Adjustment numeric value associated with the Adjustment Type.

columns.name: LIST_PRICE
columns.description: LIST_PRICE

columns.name: ALLOW_CUSTOM_ADJUSTMENTS_FLAG
columns.description: ALLOW_CUSTOM_ADJUSTMENTS_FLAG

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: Save the individual sys task id for each input csv file

columns.description: INTERNAL_PRICING_TERMS_OVN

columns.description: Language for name columns
